harness_corrections.nvidia_stream_parser: The first NVIDIA generation attempt rejected usage-only SSE events. The parser was fixed, tested, and the NVIDIA run was repeated. Both attempts remain in the trace.
harness_corrections.planner_duplicate_counter: Duplicates are counted only within the final four atomic queries, not between the standalone field and its intentional copy in search_queries.

chunking_decision.reason: 500 characters achieved Recall@5 1.000, the highest MRR among the full-recall configurations, and Full@5 1.000. The production index was not rebuilt because the current Gemini embedding quota blocked a safe synchronized migration.

embeddings.reason: On the matched 19-case set, NVIDIA lowered Recall@5 and MRR. Its latency advantage does not pass the quality gate.

reranking.reason: NVIDIA improved rank 1 and MRR but reduced Recall@3, Recall@5, and Full@5 while adding hosted inference latency.

generation.reason: NVIDIA preserved safe refusal but only 9.1% of supported completed cases passed answer correctness after strict citation validation. The live Gemini comparison was quota-limited, so the accepted current quality baseline remains controlling.

planning.reason: The NVIDIA planner produced lower downstream quality than the fixed-query reference and had multi-second latency. Gemini could not complete the direct comparison because of quota exhaustion.

final_architecture.chunking: 500-character target after a controlled reindex; current runtime remains 800 until then
final_architecture.citation_validation: deterministic claim-level validator with one bounded repair

business_controls.recall_at_5_and_full_at_5: Complete policy evidence for governed operational decisions

remaining_limitations: Gemini free-tier quotas blocked the expanded embedding, generation, and planner comparison.
Generation used a fixed 14-case stratified sample, not all 50 questions.
The corpus has only five fictional documents and 12 to 66 chunks depending on configuration.
NVIDIA hosted trial behavior does not predict dedicated NIM throughput or cost.
The deterministic citation entailment check is lexical and can reject valid paraphrases.
The 500-character chunking winner has not been promoted to the runtime index.
